summary: Place MCP-based AI operator access after Phase 8, where scoped authorization, stable supported API compatibility and recovery procedures exist. Ship it in every Controller build but disable it by default until an administrator visibly enables an MCP service principal in Nex Controller. It is Controller-scoped administrator/authentication state under the existing closed exception, not a pool setting. API impact: new contract when implemented (MCP transport and scoped agent credentials); none for this roadmap-only change. The MCP server stays a stateless Controller adapter over existing Controller-to-Core operations and introduces no pool state.

guide.reason: MCP access is planned and unavailable, so no operator workflow exists to document yet.

api.reason: The planned-coverage table records the future MCP client-facing contract, visible disabled-by-default Controller enablement and Controller-only routing. No implemented endpoint, command or schema changes in this roadmap-only change.

state.reason: Roadmap and API planning documentation only; no Nex Controller or Nex Core state is added. The planned MCP adapter is stateless; its future enabled service principal is Controller-scoped administrator/authentication state, while pool state remains on Nex Core.

verification.method: Run the documentation gate and inspect that MCP is planned after Phase 8, ships disabled until visibly enabled in Nex Controller, and makes no implemented API claim or Controller-owned pool-state claim.
